title: A carried Codex test withheld after a successful run is still counted as a credited carried check when the turn's checks are trimmed
outcome: The checkpoint's trim of resolved checks (engram_trim_turn_checks) protects only carried checks that are actually reported, so a carried Codex test withheld by engram_withhold_unjudged_successes no longer takes a protected place; the comment near engram_host_adapter.rs ~:4856 that a credited carried gate is never withheld is corrected.
acceptance: carried_count passed to engram_trim_turn_checks counts only carried checks still in the report after withholding, and a test with more than ENGRAM_TURN_CHECK_LIMIT resolved checks, one of them a withheld carried Codex test, shows the turn's own check kept.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
